question: Out of sample: on Binance USD-M alts 2020-01..2025-05, do first weekly 1618 touches whose bar opens 04:00-08:00 Beijing hold more often?
success_criterion: 04-08 Beijing validity >38.2 with week-cluster bootstrap 95 lower bound >38.2, validity gap vs other hours one-sided within-week permutation p<0.01, and mean R >0.
limitations: 15m conservative ordering, delisted symbols included, fee 0, independent R; Binance not OKX.
